messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile-friendly arena fighting game titled “Dragon Ball: Universal Showdown” with anime cel-shaded visuals and battle HUD.

## Requirements
- 2D/3D arena style with glowing aura and Ki blasts.
- Green health bar, blue Ki bar beneath it, and combo counter.
- Controls: movement via arrows/WASD; light J, heavy K, guard L, charge Ki I, Ki blast O.
- Support phone/tablet touch controls; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone responsive HTML Canvas game with original drawn characters and arena, avoiding external game-engine dependencies.
- UI text is English despite the request being in Portuguese.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created arena scene, fighters, combat, AI opponent, attacks, guard, Ki charging, projectiles, combos, timer, pause/restart, victory/defeat states, and touch controls.
- Added responsive HUD and controls for desktop and mobile.
- Validated JavaScript syntax; browser smoke test confirmed combat changes opponent/player health and combo.
- Captured and inspected desktop and mobile screenshots at `/tmp/opencode/universal-showdown.jpg` and `/tmp/opencode/universal-showdown-mobile.jpg`.

### Active
- No active work.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. If desired, address any requested changes or polish; current implementation is playable.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI structure and controls.
- `styles.css`: Responsive styling and HUD/touch controls.
- `game.js`: Canvas rendering, fighter logic, combat, AI, and input.

## Important Context
- Files are uncommitted.
- Local browser testing used `http://localhost:3002`; one browser console error was only a missing `/favicon.ico` (404).

content.text:
**Dragon Ball: Universal Showdown** está pronto e jogável.

- Arena com visual anime, perspectiva pseudo-3D, auras e efeitos de Ki.
- Combate contra um oponente controlado pela IA, com vida, Ki, combos, pausa e reinício.
- Controles: WASD/setas para mover; J ataque leve; K pesado; L defesa; I carregar Ki; O disparar.
- Controles de toque para celular e tablet.

Os arquivos do jogo são `index.html`, `styles.css` e `game.js`. Verifiquei a sintaxe e testei o combate no navegador, incluindo a redução de vida e o contador de combo.

**Nota:** a arena é desenhada em Canvas 2D com perspectiva para criar um efeito pseudo-3D; não usa um motor 3D. As capturas de verificação estão em `/tmp/opencode/universal-showdown.jpg` e `/tmp/opencode/universal-showdown-mobile.jpg`.
